name: Jarl Needs a Blade
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
I have cutting to do.  I can't tell you what I'm going to cut, but... I need myself a blade.  A certain blade...

Some people call it a moonsteel broadsword.  I call it a swing blade.

You help me?  Maybe you find it in town, maybe you talk to a blacksmith and he'll make it special.

But don't sleep on this.  What I'm cutting won't keep forever...
narrative.objectives: Bring a Moonsteel Broadsword to Jarl in Dustwallow Marsh.
narrative.offerRewardText:
That's a good blade. It has a good swing. It's a good swing blade. Thank you. Thank you, thank you, thank you!!! Now I want to try it....

Later. I'll try it later. But like I was saying... thanks.
